description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter e-commerce app. It constructs the main homepage UI with multiple sections like offers carousel, popular products, flash sale, banners, best sellers, and more, using various custom components and navigation triggers.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the main homepage interface, assembled with various sections for showcasing products, banners, and offers in a scrollable view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, laying out a Scaffold with a SafeArea containing a CustomScrollView of various Sliver components representing different sections of the homepage.
